name: Machine Made Worlds
description: Essays, practical guides and field notes on artificial intelligence, automation and the things we build.

topic_descriptions.local-ai: Run capable models on your own hardware: quantized setups, VRAM budgets, and private workflows that keep data local and costs predictable.
topic_descriptions.automation: Small dependable pipelines for solo builders: capture ideas, synthesize drafts, and ship static pages without another dashboard to babysit.
topic_descriptions.design: Design notes on readable, fast static pages: dark-first contrast, elevation cues, and lightweight CSS that stays quiet while you read.
topic_descriptions.essays: Longer reflections on building with AI: what worked, what failed, and what slow useful writing still owes readers in a noisy feed.
